components.name: Primary Send Button
components.description: Compact primary CTA inside the unified composer and approval cards.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; padding: 9px 18px; border-radius: 8px; border: 1px solid #1d4ed8; background: #1d4ed8; color: #ffffff; font-family: 'Be Vietnam Pro', sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; white-space: nowrap; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 150ms ease, transform 120ms ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #1e40af; border-color: #1e40af; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: scale(0.98); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #1d4ed8; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Citation Cross-Link Chip
components.description: Calm inline citation pill linking directly to the slide-over source preview.
components.css: .ds-cite-link { display: inline-flex; align-items: baseline; gap: 7px; padding: 6px 10px; border-radius: 8px; border: 1px solid #d8dee6; background: #f8fafc; color: #334155; font-size: 12.5px; font-weight: 500; text-align: left; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 150ms ease, border-color 150ms ease, color 150ms ease; } .ds-cite-link:hover { background: #eff6ff; border-color: #bfdbfe; color: #1d4ed8; } .ds-cite-link[aria-pressed="true"] { background: #1d4ed8; border-color: #1d4ed8; color: #ffffff; } .ds-cite-code { font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; font-weight: 600; white-space: nowrap; }

components.name: Unified Composer Box

components.css: .ds-composer-box { display: flex; align-items: flex-end; gap: 10px; padding: 8px 8px 8px 14px; border-radius: 12px; border: 1px solid #d8dee6; background: #f8fafc; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(15,23,42,0.04); } .ds-composer-box:focus-within { border-color: #1d4ed8; background: #ffffff; } .ds-composer-input { flex: 1; border: none; background: transparent; resize: none; padding: 7px 0; font-size: 15px; color: #0f172a; } .ds-composer-input:focus { outline: none; }

narrative.overview:
Designed as a calm, low-clutter operational helpdesk for AI20K L3A learners in bright lab sessions and coordinators reviewing coach handoff drafts. The shell pairs a committed deep-navy navigation rail (`#132238`) with an expansive white workspace (`#ffffff`) centered at `780px` reading width, while keeping source verification and execution trace tucked inside an on-demand slide-over drawer (`Chi tiết & Trace`).

Instead of stacked telemetry banners, redundant card chrome, or label overload on every turn, answers read as clean prose anchored by a single quiet footer linking directly to source codes and trace metrics.
keyCharacteristics: Calm two-column workspace by default (`248px` navy rail + `1fr` workspace), revealing technical trace and full source text only when requested.
Minimal inline metadata per message: clean prose, clickable source citation chips, and compact handoff confirmation bars.
Self-hosted `Be Vietnam Pro` (`400–700`) and `JetBrains Mono` (`400–700`) `.woff2` font files with zero external CDN dependency.
Hairline dividers (`#e6ebf1`) and open whitespace replacing nested boxed cards.

rules.name: The Quiet Surface Rule
rules.body: Keep default chat turns free of boxed card borders and telemetry badges; reserve colored surfaces strictly for pending coach handoffs, active drawer inspection, and form errors.

dos: Do keep conversation turns scannable as plain prose with at most one compact source footer and one inline action bar when a coach handoff draft exists.
Do progressively disclose trace logs and full announcement excerpts inside the on-demand `Chi tiết & Trace` drawer.
Do restore keyboard focus to the exact triggering button when closing any slide-over drawer.
donts: Don't render permanent 3-column telemetry dashboards or multi-step diagnostic banners inside everyday learner replies.
Don't stack redundant status tags (`Mẫu demo`, token pills, or uppercase eyebrows) above headings or cards.
Don't send external coach handoffs automatically without coordinator approval in the queue.
